title: Song - It Came Upon the Midnight Clear (simplified)
subtitle: Arrangement: the tune with left-hand block chords
trains: It Came Upon the Midnight Clear in B♭ major and 6/8, with an eighth-note pickup, over one held block chord a bar in the left (B♭, E♭, F).

provenance.author: claude-opus-5.5
provenance.basedOn: mutopia-1231-carol: Carol (hymntune, R. S. Willis: It Came Upon the Midnight Clear), SATB, B-flat major; the tune is in the Soprano (https://www.mutopiaproject.org/cgibin/piece-info.cgi?id=1231)
provenance.note: Melody from www.cyberhymnal.org (https://www.mutopiaproject.org/cgibin/piece-info.cgi?id=1231), public domain; left-hand chords our own (CC0)

departures: Left-hand block chords are our own (CC0).
Simplified: one block chord a bar, held, with the three primary chords only (B♭, E♭, F), instead of the full version's moving left hand.
Slower: 72 instead of 84 quarter notes a minute.
